description: This file defines a custom exception class `TableNotFoundException` used within the `com.romraider.xml` package, likely related to handling cases where a database or data table cannot be located.

classes.name: TableNotFoundException
classes.description: A final class extending `Exception`, representing a specific error when a database table is not found. It overrides the `getMessage()` method to provide a fixed error message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the string "Table not found." indicating the specified error condition.
